_readme: Extra recommender test set, groups F and G, drafted to exercise what groups A-E never do. Group F re-uses the ingredients of an existing A/B query and ticks 1-3 seasonings (the seasoning bonus, SEASONING_WEIGHT, recommender/recommend.py). Group G re-uses the ingredients of an existing query with category = savory or dessert (the category picker). Every query has health_tags = [] and excluded = [], so the only changed factor is the seasonings or the category. 'paired_with' names the existing query in data/eval/test_set_draft_v1.json that has the same ingredients, no seasonings and category 'all'. Fields follow test_set_draft_v1.json (id, text_th, ingredients, health_tags, excluded) plus seasonings, category, purpose and paired_with; preview_top3 is deliberately not included. text_th is display text only: the evaluation uses the keys. Shape follows data/recommender_dev_set.json ({_readme, ..., list}). The existing eval pipeline cannot score these queries yet: tools/eval_dump_top3.py passes no per-query seasonings or category, and tools/eval_rule_score.py GROUPS stops at E.

notes.zero_or_thin_category_results: Expected behavior, not a bug. Counts of recipes with a positive match in the 390-recipe catalog: dessert mode returns 0 recipes for the ingredient sets of A2 (chicken), A3 (pork), A4 (shrimp), A5 (tofu), A6 (minced_meat), B4 (shrimp, lemongrass, galangal), B5 (fish, ginger), B6 (beef, basil) and E3 (rice_noodle); savory mode returns 0 for E1 (banana) and only 2 for E5 (glutinous_rice, banana). Group G uses only sets that have both categories: A1 egg (48 savory / 23 dessert), E2 coconut + pumpkin (7 / 18), B8 cabbage + carrot + egg (73 / 24).
